tasks.label: Test API
tasks.command:
uv run python3 << 'PYTHON_EOF'
import sympy as sp
import mct

# Define Kraus operators
lam = sp.symbols('lambda', real=True, positive=True)
K0 = sp.Matrix([[1, 0], [0, sp.sqrt(1 - lam)]])
K1 = sp.Matrix([[0, sp.sqrt(lam)], [0, 0]])

# Call API
result = mct.superoperator(
    kraus_ops=(K0, K1),
    basis_state=mct.computational_basis[0],
    basis=mct.computational_basis,
    qubits=1
)

P_symbolic, metadata = result
print("✓ superoperator() works!")
print(f"  P shape: {P_symbolic.shape}")
print(f"  Free symbols: {P_symbolic.free_symbols}")
print(f"  P(λ) = \n{P_symbolic}")

# Generate code
code = mct.markov_chain(result)
print(f"\n✓ markov_chain() works!")
print(f"  Generated {len(code)} chars of Python code")
print(f"\nGenerated function (excerpt):\n{code[:200]}...")
PYTHON_EOF

import sympy as sp
from sympy import Matrix, sqrt, symbols
import mct
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')

lam = symbols('lambda', real=True, positive=True)
K0 = Matrix([[1, 0], [0, sqrt(1 - lam)]])
K1 = Matrix([[0, sqrt(lam)], [0, 0]])
P_sym, _ = mct.derive_transition_matrix([K0, K1], mct.computational_basis)

print("P_sym symbols:", P_sym.free_symbols)
P = np.array(P_sym.subs(lam, 0.2), dtype=float)
print(f"Transition matrix P (λ=0.2):\n{P}")

print("\nTesting distributions...")
n_steps = 5
n_traj = 100000

print("Computing theoretical distribution...")
theory_dist = mct.theoretical_distribution_after_steps(P, initial_state=1, n_steps=n_steps)
print(f"Theory: {theory_dist}")

print("Simulating trajectories...")
trajectories = mct.simulate_markov_vectorized(P, initial_state=1, n_steps=n_steps, n_trajectories=n_traj)
print(f"Trajectories shape: {trajectories.shape}")

print("Computing empirical distribution...")
empirical_dist = mct.empirical_distribution_from_trajectories(trajectories, step=n_steps, n_states=2)
print(f"Empirical: {empirical_dist}")

error = np.linalg.norm(theory_dist - empirical_dist)
print(f"L2 error: {error:.8f}")
EOF

import sympy as sp
from sympy import Matrix, sqrt, symbols
import mct
import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')  # Non-interactive backend
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

print("\n[NOTEBOOK 01] Single-Qubit T1")
print("-" * 60)

# Setup
lam = symbols('lambda', real=True, positive=True)
K0 = Matrix([[1, 0], [0, sqrt(1 - lam)]])
K1 = Matrix([[0, sqrt(lam)], [0, 0]])
print("✓ Imports and setup")

# Derive
P, metadata = mct.derive_transition_matrix([K0, K1], mct.computational_basis, channel_name="T1")
print(f"✓ Symbolic derivation: P shape {P.shape}")

# Verify stochasticity
for lam_val in [0.0, 0.1, 0.5, 0.9, 1.0]:
    P_num, is_valid = mct.substitute_and_verify(P, lam, lam_val, name="")
    assert is_valid
print("✓ Stochasticity verification at 5 parameter values")

# Use as MarkovChain
P_num, _ = mct.substitute_and_verify(P, lam, 0.3)
mc = mct.MarkovChain(P_num, state_labels=['|0⟩', '|1⟩'], name='T1')
result = mc.validate_stochasticity()
assert result['is_valid']
print("✓ MarkovChain creation and validation")

# Generate code
code = mct.markov_chain((P, metadata), parameter_values={'lambda': 0.3})
assert len(code) > 50
print(f"✓ Sampling code generation ({len(code)} chars)")

print("\n[NOTEBOOK 02] API Quickstart")
print("-" * 60)

# Define
lam = symbols('lambda', real=True, positive=True)
K0 = Matrix([[1, 0], [0, sqrt(1 - lam)]])
K1 = Matrix([[0, sqrt(lam)], [0, 0]])
print("✓ Kraus operators defined")

# Derive
P, meta = mct.derive_transition_matrix([K0, K1], mct.computational_basis, "T1")
print(f"✓ Symbolic matrix: {P.shape}")

# Verify
P_num, valid = mct.substitute_and_verify(P, lam, 0.5, name="")
assert valid
print("✓ Parameter verification at λ=0.5")

# MarkovChain
mc = mct.MarkovChain(P_num, state_labels=['|0⟩', '|1⟩'], name='T1')
assert mc.validate_stochasticity()['is_valid']
print("✓ MarkovChain valid")

# Code
code = mct.markov_chain((P, meta), parameter_values={'lambda': 0.5})
print(f"✓ Generated {len(code)} chars of sampling code")

print("\n[NOTEBOOK 03] Monte Carlo Validation")
print("-" * 60)

# Setup
lam = symbols('lambda', real=True, positive=True)
K0 = Matrix([[1, 0], [0, sqrt(1 - lam)]])
K1 = Matrix([[0, sqrt(lam)], [0, 0]])
P_sym, _ = mct.derive_transition_matrix([K0, K1], mct.computational_basis)
P, _ = mct.substitute_and_verify(P_sym, lam, 0.2, name="")
print(f"✓ Setup: P (λ=0.2) shape {P.shape}")

# Theory vs Empirical
n_steps = 5
n_traj = 10000
theory_dist = mct.theoretical_distribution_after_steps(P, initial_state=1, n_steps=n_steps)
trajectories = mct.simulate_markov_vectorized(P, initial_state=1, n_steps=n_steps, n_trajectories=n_traj)
empirical_dist = mct.empirical_distribution_from_trajectories(trajectories, step=n_steps, n_states=2)
error = np.linalg.norm(theory_dist - empirical_dist)
print(f"✓ Theory vs Empirical: error = {error:.6f} (n_traj={n_traj})")

# Plot (non-interactive)
plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))
x = np.arange(2)
width = 0.35
plt.bar(x - width/2, theory_dist, width, label='Theoretical')
plt.bar(x + width/2, empirical_dist, width, label='Empirical')
plt.xlabel('State')
plt.ylabel('Probability')
plt.legend()
plt.close()
print(f"✓ Plot created (theoretical vs empirical)")

# Decay analysis
n_steps_max = 10
trajectories_long = mct.simulate_markov_vectorized(P, initial_state=1, n_steps=n_steps_max, n_trajectories=n_traj)
theory_decay = np.array([mct.theoretical_distribution_after_steps(P, initial_state=1, n_steps=n)[1] 
                         for n in range(n_steps_max + 1)])
empirical_decay = np.array([mct.empirical_distribution_from_trajectories(trajectories_long, step=n, n_states=2)[1] 
                           for n in range(n_steps_max + 1)])
max_error = np.linalg.norm(theory_decay - empirical_decay, np.inf)
print(f"✓ Decay analysis: max error = {max_error:.6f}")

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 5))
plt.plot(range(n_steps_max + 1), theory_decay, 'o-', label='Theoretical')
plt.plot(range(n_steps_max + 1), empirical_decay, 's--', label='Empirical')
plt.legend()
plt.close()
print(f"✓ Decay plot created")

print("\n" + "="*60)
print("✓✓✓ ALL NOTEBOOKS VERIFIED - NO ERRORS ✓✓✓")
print("="*60 + "\n")
EOF
